Jharkhand Recruitment Protests: Hunger Strike, Police Action, and Hospitalization

Devendra Nath Mahto, a leader of the Jharkhand Loktantrik Krantikari Morcha (JLKM), was admitted to the hospital after his hunger strike entered its tenth day. The protest, concerning alleged police lathi-charge on job aspirants, saw students breach barricades and face police action, including lathi-charge. The CJP (Citizens for Justice and Peace) organization hailed Mahto's role in the Ranchi protest. Meanwhile, the BJP questioned the Congress regarding the situation in Jharkhand, while the TMC faced internal divisions with 'rebel' MLAs joining a protest camp.
